title: one scannable page of flagged and reviewed Posts, decided in one tap

criteria.text: Operator-only Posts page, one row per subject (Post with its photos, Page photo, Page picture); non-operators 404
criteria.note: `page.tsx` gates on `reports.review`, `groupBySubject` rolls reports per subject incl. `page_picture`, `post_photo` [V] Checked: unmarked: `tests/admin-reports-gate.test.ts`, `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Row shows thumbnail, 120-char excerpt, badge, reasons+count, AI read, rebuttal, reporter counters + coordinated flag, status, age
criteria.note: All shown except status "under appeal": no appeal state exists anywhere in code [V grep]. Appeals are out of scope in the scenario's "Not this" Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`. Filed: none (SPEC-CONFLICT).

criteria.text: Severity 1–4, highest open tier; shadow = reporter's, live = higher of the two
criteria.note: `review-subjects.ts` tier map, `ai_mode` data flag (#513) [V] Checked: yes (`[guards F101.3]`).

criteria.text: Order severity then oldest; sort severity/age/count; filter by status; header counts by severity
criteria.note: Sort has all three; filter is Waiting/All, not hidden/restored/removed individually [V]; header counts by severity [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Approve/Remove full-width, 48 px+, bottom half of row; Approve restores, Remove keeps down
criteria.note: `min-h-12` buttons in the row footer [V] Checked: unmarked (partial marker covers height only).

criteria.text: Swipe right approves, left removes, colour and word revealed
criteria.note: `ReviewQueue.tsx` pointer handlers, green/red reveal [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx` (right swipe only).

criteria.text: One tap or swipe per decision; severity-1 Approve asks once more
criteria.note: Severity-1 confirm in row [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: No confirm dialog; 5-second Undo; undone writes no decision and tells nobody
criteria.note: Decision held client-side five seconds before the server call [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx` ("Undo ... writes nothing").

criteria.text: Next waiting row moves into place after each decision
criteria.note: Row removed from the list on decide [V] Checked: unmarked (50-row keystroke test is partial for 15).

criteria.text: One-tap default reason: Approve "Nothing wrong with it"; Remove matches top category; changeable in detail
criteria.note: `DEFAULT_REASON`, category reason codes (#513, migration `20261008005836`) [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: A decision writes one `report_decisions` row per open report, attributed, reversible
criteria.note: `decideReportAction` called per open report id [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx` (client call ids, not the database rows).

criteria.text: Tap row: full history, every report, assessment, rebuttal, decision, newest first, Undo on any decision
criteria.note: Reports, decisions with Undo, rebuttal and latest AI read exist. Every earlier AI read is missing (build log 486) Checked: unmarked: `ReportEntry.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Severity 1–3 thumbnails blurred until pressed and held; severity 4 plain
criteria.note: Blur by tier exists; reveal is a tap toggle, not press-and-hold (`onClick` flips `peek`) [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx` (tests the tap).

criteria.text: Desktop keys: A approves, R removes, J/K move, U undoes
criteria.note: Key handler in `ReviewQueue.tsx` [V] Checked: unmarked: `ReviewQueue.test.tsx` (R, U tested; A, J, K not).

criteria.text: 50 rows clearable in under 10 minutes on a phone, browser test at 375 px
criteria.note: `evals/features/F101-report-decisions-at-375.spec.ts`, 50 decisions in 23.7 s [V PR #538] Checked: yes (`[guards F101.15]`).
